programme.title: Raavan
programme.desc: A bandit kidnaps a police officer's wife as revenge, but the lines between good and evil blur.

programme.title: One Day: Justice Delivered
programme.desc: A judge bound by law has to pass unfair judgments on some criminal cases due to lack of evidence. After retirement, he becomes a vigilante and decides to punish the crooks who walk free.

programme.title: Veerey Ki Wedding
programme.desc: Veerey and Geet fall in love and decide to get married. Their plan gets tossed out of the window when her peace-loving father sees Veerey getting involved in a fight, if only to protect a girl, and stamps him as a violent roadside Romeo.

programme.title: Emi
programme.desc: A film that tells the story of a group of people who fall prey to credit card debt and are struggling to repay their loans. They come together to form a support group and devise a plan to fight against the corrupt practices of the credit card companies. The movie highlights the consequences of reckless spending and the importance of financial literacy in an engaging and thought-provoking plot.

programme.title: Bobby Jasoos
programme.desc: A rich man asks Bobby, a private detective, to find two girls and a boy in return for a huge sum. Although she accomplishes the assigned tasks, she struggles to understand the motive behind them.

programme.title: Chalo Dilli
programme.desc: Mihika, an investment banker, misses her flight to Delhi and meets Manu Gupta, a talkative man. In order to reach Delhi on time, she must tag along with Manu and put up with his antics.
